note: Art/motion rework requests. Frames are 0-based indices of sprites/<view>/NNNN.png. Every fix keeps the 720x1280 canvas, the BG02 camera and the root path of its clip unless the request itself is about the path.

requests.problem: The leg nearer the camera is a flat texture strip stretched along the projected hip-heel line (up to 1.72x the far leg, NPC03 front 46). No foreshortening, and the shin strip sits on the thigh with a blurred band at the knee, so it reads as a long stovepipe leg.
requests.fix: Redraw the near leg for frames toward the camera with foreshortening (knee overlap, shorter visible shin, trouser folds), or render legs from a volume model; remove the knee band. Re-export the affected front/rear frames on the same 720x1280 canvas and path.

requests.problem: The torso is one texture with at most about 1 deg roll (render.js sin(frame)*0.018 rad). No shoulder/pelvis counter-rotation, small arm swing; the figure glides.
requests.fix: Add shoulder and pelvis counter-rotation (shoulder line and hip line visibly opposite over the cycle) and a matching arm swing; keep the face texture unchanged.

requests.problem: Knee stays bent while the foot is flat on the floor: up to 44.4 deg on walk_rig_scene_retimed_v01 and 42.9 deg on walk_rig_elder_v04. Reads as a crouched walk.
requests.fix: Retime the rig so the stance knee straightens to about 5-20 deg after loading (elder rig may stay a little more bent if that is the design intent, stated in the rig). Re-render side, front and rear from the corrected rig.

requests.problem: Enter ends mid-stride facing the camera and exit starts mid-stride facing away. requests.problem: render.js line 50 places every clip on fixed paths: front z = 2.92 - p0, rear z = 1.8 + p0. The elder rig walks 0.587 m in 47 frames (0.34 m/s), so enter ends at z 2.333 m while exit starts at z 1.8 m: 0.533 m at the root, 0.437 m measured from the lowest silhouette row (the 0.44 m reported before), head width +28.1 % in the images.
requests.fix: Start the rear path where the enter clip ends: rear z = (2.92 - root_x(47) * S) + p0 for walk_rig_elder_v04 (2.333 m), or derive both path constants from the rig travel for every NPC. Re-render NPC06 rear (exit) frames. The engine must not stretch or shift the frames to hide it.
